title: Jubilant Dense Turkish Avocado Kazandibi
description: A dense and creamy Turkish dessert featuring avocado hass pulp, served in a stone bowl dolsot, this dish is a unique hangover cure, cultured and gluten free friendly, formed as kazandibi and served in a copper mug.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together milk, sugar, and rose water, and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved.
In a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch and a splash of the warm milk mixture until smooth.
Add the cornstarch mixture back into the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the egg yolks and unsalted butter until well combined.
Fold in the avocado hass pulp until smooth and creamy.
Pour the mixture into a copper mug and refrigerate until chilled.
Top with chopped pistachio and serve in a stone bowl dolsot.
Garnish with additional rose water and pistachio if desired.
